why: Item 1 is missed. Verifier Check 4 curls the live page ("curl ... https://o.github.io/greet-cli/") and calls line 4 "not yet verifiable" before merge. It never checks at the PR head what will publish the page: it doesn't confirm that docs/index.md lists --shout or that .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. Item 2 is missed.
